audit.whatIsWrong: The chart says Ryze / Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon / Ryze / Pantheon / Pantheon, but report[2].t on the same page states the opposite in words: 'He owns levels 1 through first item — you take over at two items.' whys[0] and whys[4] both describe Pantheon-favoured windows while the chart credits Ryze, and whys[6] plus the late paragraph describe a Ryze takeover the chart denies.
audit.why: 50.00% over 280 games with a front-loaded bully versus a scaling mage: Pantheon owns everything up to first item, Ryze takes two items. That is the packet chart and it is what this page's own prose already says everywhere except the chart itself.
audit.corrected: Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Ryze, proposed as matched full+content pairs for the four rows that change, with ratings adjusted.

audit.why: Four spikes and they are the right ones: Lvl 2 Shield Vault (13/12/11/10/9s point-click stun with a dash), Lvl 3 Aegis Assault, 1st item Seraph's, 2+ items. The level-2 rush being the biggest danger spike is correctly called out in breakdown.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says to wait out Aegis Assault, but never states the far better answer: Aegis Assault is a channel, so Rune Prison cancels it. Shield Vault's auto-attack reset is never named as the tell. Two cooldown numbers are simply wrong: breakdown.cooldowns calls Aegis Assault '~12 s' and dosFull[2].d calls Grand Starfall 'an 80-second roam tool'.
audit.why: Kit: Aegis Assault is 22/21/20/19/18s at 400 range with channel, shield and untargetable flags — Riot's text says invulnerable to damage from the front, so it is a frontal block, not omnidirectional, and a channel any CC ends. Shield Vault carries the autoReset flag. Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s, not 80. Mirror-confirmed: Rune Prison (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 615) is Ryze's only root and needs Spell Flux to root at all; Overload's 1000 range beats Comet Spear's 575.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison cancels the Aegis Assault channel outright rather than waiting it out; the block only covers his front; Shield Vault's attack wind-up is the step-back cue; Aegis Assault is 18-22s and Grand Starfall is 150-180s.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames ('His Aegis Assault', 'Use Comet Spear', 'His Grand Starfall') are false positives — the names are spelled correctly and the detector is matching on the surrounding words.

edits.before: The spin blocks the projectile — wait two seconds for it to end, then root and Q.
edits.after: Aegis Assault is a channel — Rune Prison cancels it outright, so root, don't poke.

edits.before: That is the exact moment he wants you to walk forward. Trade only when his stun is on cooldown.
edits.after: Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to leave.

edits.before: His R is an 80-second roam tool. Ping it the moment it vanishes and use Realm Warp to contest or match his pressure cross-map.
edits.after: His R is a 150-180s roam tool. Ping it the moment it vanishes and use Realm Warp to contest or match his pressure cross-map.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (W stun): point-and-click, matchup-defining — this is the ability that kills you. Track it every trade and step up only when it is on cooldown. - His Aegis Assault (E block): ~12 s cooldown, blocks your Q and empowered Q during the spin — wait for it to end before committing your root. - Comet Spear empowered Q dash: a targeted dash after Mortal Will — recognize the glow and side-step at cast.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (W stun): 9-13s, point-and-click, matchup-defining — this is the ability that kills you. Step up only when it is down. - His Aegis Assault (E block): 18-22s, blocks damage from the front and is a channel — Rune Prison cancels it instead of waiting it out. - Comet Spear: 575 range against your 1000, so poke it from outside and side-step when Mortal Will glows.

notes: Two hard cooldown errors corrected: Aegis Assault was written as ~12s (really 18-22s) and Grand Starfall as 80s (really 150-180s). The best addition here is that Aegis Assault is a channel — Rune Prison cancels it, which is strictly better than the 'wait two seconds' advice the page repeated in four places. I changed the two shortest of those places; early, mid and report[5].t still say 'wait for the block to end', which is not wrong, just weaker.
